sections.heading: Product Details
sections.text:
💧 Provides deep hydration keeping lips smooth nourished daily

 

 

 
 

 
 

 
 

 💋 Softens lips while preventing dryness and rough texture

 

 

 
 

 
 

 
 

 🩹 Heals chapped lips reducing cracks irritation effectively

 

 

 
 

 
 

 
 

 🌞 Protects from sun damage boosting collagen fuller lips

sections.heading: How To Use?
sections.text:
1-Exfoliate your lips using Puchhi Balm and wash off thoroughly.

2-Now, apply an even and thick layer of Lip bright mask on your lips.

3-Let it sit for 15 minutes and peel it off inwards..

 Product Description
 
 

 
 
 

 

 

 
 
 Show some love to your lips, as they work overtime. Make the dead and chapped lips alive with Nuskhe By Paras Gold Peel Off Lip Mask. Add this little treat to your daily skincare routine to see some golden magic.

✻ NOTE:- People with sensitive skin are advised to perform a patch test. If a rash, redness, or itching appears, stop using it.

Customer Care at +91-78600 00768, available from 10 AM to 6 PM (Monday to Saturday)
